clock.clockworkdiver.pocket_watch.desc: A golden pocket watch that has kept its owner's time for many years. A precise wheel train fills its little case.
clock.clockworkdiver.cuckoo.desc: A carved wooden cuckoo clock shaped like a forest cabin. A little bird pops out on the hour.
clock.clockworkdiver.astronomical.desc: A deep blue dial tracking the sun, the moon and the zodiac. Layers of gears recreate the dance of the stars.
clock.clockworkdiver.birdcage.desc: A mysterious clock where a clockwork songbird sings under a glass dome.
clock.clockworkdiver.steam_tower.desc: An iron tower clock driven by steam. Its gauges and pipes rumble like the heart of the city.
clock.clockworkdiver.orrery.desc: A great clock where planets circle the sun. One of the most intricate timepieces in the city.
defect.clockworkdiver.rust.desc: Rust has seized a gear. Dive in and smash every rust cluster with your wrench. Watch out for the rust mites crawling out.
defect.clockworkdiver.teeth.desc: Cog gremlins stole the teeth. Defeat the glowing gremlins, take the teeth back and fit them into the sockets.
defect.clockworkdiver.screw.desc: A giant screw came loose. Climb its thread like a spiral stair and turn the slot in its head on the beat.
defect.clockworkdiver.spring.desc: The spring has run down. Turn the central crank with your wrench to wind it. Enemies near the crank unwind it.
defect.clockworkdiver.nest.desc: A Time Eater, a beast that devours time, nests here. Only Just Tick blows can crack its shell.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.gregory.offer.0: Ah, you must be the new clockmaker. I'm Gregory - the oldest customer in this town.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.gregory.offer.1: My late wife gave me this pocket watch. One morning it simply stopped... Something inside seems to have rusted.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.gregory.wait: Hm, time still stands still. No need to hurry. ...Well, perhaps hurry a little.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.gregory.deliver: Oh... that sound in your hands! Is it fixed?
dialogue.clockworkdiver.gregory.thanks.0: Tick, tock... ah, that's the sound. It reminds me of the nights I danced with my wife.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.gregory.thanks.1: Splendid work. The clocks of this town will come to rely on you, I'm sure.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.ada.offer.0: You're the famous 'diving clockmaker'! I'm Ada, an inventor.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.ada.offer.1: My masterpiece won't behave. Sparks flew out of the gears and then - snap - it stopped.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.ada.wait: How is it going? By my calculations you can definitely fix it!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.ada.deliver: That look on your face... is it fixed already?
dialogue.clockworkdiver.ada.thanks.0: Perfect! It sounds even clearer than before. You must tell me what you did in there.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.ada.thanks.1: As thanks, you'll be the first to see my next invention!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.bolt.offer.0: Hey, clockmaker! Name's Bolt, steam engineer.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.bolt.offer.1: The station clock went haywire. The train timetable is a mess and the whole town is in an uproar!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.bolt.wait: The trains are waiting, mate! ...Not that I doubt your skills.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.bolt.deliver: Whoa, that heartbeat... did you fix it?!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.bolt.thanks.0: Ha! What a sound! Now the whistles will blow right on time.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.bolt.thanks.1: I'll let you ride in the locomotive cab sometime. That's a promise!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.lily.offer.0: Hello! I'm Lily, I sell flowers. Could you look at this one for me?
dialogue.clockworkdiver.lily.offer.1: It's the precious clock that wakes me every morning, but it's been silent for three days...
dialogue.clockworkdiver.lily.wait: Is it still feeling poorly...? Take your time, please.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.lily.deliver: Oh! I think I just heard it tick!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.lily.thanks.0: It's running again! Thank you, thank you so much!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.lily.thanks.1: I'll bring you the prettiest flowers from my stall!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.celes.offer.0: Forgive the late visit. I am Celes, an astronomer.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.celes.offer.1: This clock that keeps the motion of the stars has begun to drift. A few seconds now become a whole star's width in a century.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.celes.wait: The stars will not wait. Yet I should not rush your work either.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.celes.deliver: ...The ticking matches the stars again. Surely not already?
dialogue.clockworkdiver.celes.thanks.0: Wonderful. Tonight's observations will be beautiful.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.celes.thanks.1: May I name a newly found little star after you?
dialogue.clockworkdiver.phantom.offer.0: Tonight I come as a customer. My name matters little... they call me the Phantom Thief.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.phantom.offer.1: Something nests inside this clock I stole... I mean, acquired. It is beyond my talents.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.phantom.wait: I shall not rush you. But I am not the only one who covets this clock.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.phantom.deliver: Oh? You drove out the 'thing' inside the clock?
dialogue.clockworkdiver.phantom.thanks.0: Superb, master clockmaker. Your hands are worth more than any jewel.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.phantom.thanks.1: Your fee is here, as promised. ...Let us hope we never meet as enemies.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.offer.clock: Please repair this %1$s. It seems to have %2$s faulty part(s). I'll pay %3$s brass coins.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.offer.tutorial: (Tutorial) Press 'Accept' to take the clock. Then press the 'Repair Bench' button to go to the bench and inspect the clock with the mysterious spectacles.
objective.clockworkdiver.start: Use the Workshop Key to go to your clock repair workshop
objective.clockworkdiver.wait: Wait for a customer to arrive...
objective.clockworkdiver.find: At the repair bench, move the spectacle lens to find faulty parts (%s/%s)
objective.clockworkdiver.choose: At the repair bench, pick a faulty part and dive into the clock (repaired %s/%s)
objective.clockworkdiver.deliver: Give the repaired clock back to the customer
objective.clockworkdiver.dive.rust: Smash the rust clusters with your wrench (%s/%s)
objective.clockworkdiver.dive.teeth: Take the teeth back from the glowing gremlins and fit them into the sockets (%s/%s)
objective.clockworkdiver.dive.screw: Stand on the screw head and turn it on the beat (%s/%s)
objective.clockworkdiver.dive.spring: Turn the crank to wind the spring (%s%%)
hint.clockworkdiver.workshop.0: This is your clock repair workshop. Customers will bring their clocks here.
hint.clockworkdiver.workshop.1: When a customer arrives, right click them across the counter to talk.
hint.clockworkdiver.bench.0: You got the clock! Press the 'Repair Bench' button on screen to go to the bench.
hint.clockworkdiver.bench.1: To go back later, right click the clock or right click the repair bench itself.
hint.clockworkdiver.dive.0: Inside the clock everything moves to the escapement's beat. Watch the pendulum at the top of the screen.
hint.clockworkdiver.dive.1: Strike as the pendulum crosses the centre jewel for a 'Just!' hit: more damage, combo and steam pressure.
hint.clockworkdiver.dive.2: Off-beat strikes break your combo and hit weaker. If things get dangerous, hold R to escape.
hint.clockworkdiver.rust.0: Rust clusters cover the seized gear. Smash them all with your wrench.
hint.clockworkdiver.rust.1: Hit a cluster with Just timing to shatter it in one blow!
hint.clockworkdiver.teeth.0: The escape wheel's teeth were stolen! The glowing cog gremlins carry them.
hint.clockworkdiver.teeth.1: Defeat them, pick up the teeth and right click the sockets at the back to fit them.
hint.clockworkdiver.screw.0: A giant screw came loose. Climb its thread like a spiral staircase.
hint.clockworkdiver.screw.1: On top, right click the slot with the wrench. Just turns drive it in; bad timing throws you off!
hint.clockworkdiver.spring.0: Right click the central crank with your wrench to wind the spring.
hint.clockworkdiver.spring.1: Enemies near the crank unwind it. Balance winding and defending.
hint.clockworkdiver.nest.0: The Time Eater's shell only cracks under Just Tick blows.
hint.clockworkdiver.nest.1: A ring of light on the floor warns of a time pulse. Piston Dash away!
hint.clockworkdiver.steam.0: Steam pressure is up! Right click the wrench for a Steam Burst that blasts enemies away.
hint.clockworkdiver.steam.1: Sneak + right click for a Piston Dash. Stand on a steam vent to refill steam.
hint.clockworkdiver.after.0: Tutorial complete! From now on all kinds of customers will bring strange clocks.
hint.clockworkdiver.after.1: As your reputation grows, intricate clocks like astronomical clocks and orreries appear.
hint.clockworkdiver.after.2: Spend brass coins in the bench's 'Upgrade' tab to improve your tools.
title.clockworkdiver.boss.sub: Crack its shell with Just Ticks!
title.clockworkdiver.enraged.sub: The Time Eater quickened the beat

message.clockworkdiver.screw_slip: Clang! Off beat - the screw threw you off!

message.clockworkdiver.fainted: You fainted and were thrown out of the clock...
message.clockworkdiver.boss_shell: The shell is too hard! Attack with Just Ticks
message.clockworkdiver.steam_outside: Steam techniques only work inside a clock
